title: Titan Pro 15K Strawberry Kiwi Watermelon Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Strawberry Kiwi Watermelon delivers a smooth, summery blend of ripe fruit flavours. Juicy Strawberry meets tangy Kiwi and refreshing Watermelon in a bright, balanced combination. Each pack contains a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container for the Titan Pro 15K device. The mesh coil provides steady flavour clarity, while the refill design maintains coil saturation for lasting quality. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
